description: Developed and maintained customer and administrator applications using React Native, ReactJS, and Node.js, featuring real-time auction bidding, push notifications, social authentication, and analytics. Published mobile apps to the App Store and Google Play, optimized performance by approximately 30%, and upgraded React Native and dependencies to improve compatibility and maintainability.

Developed agency commission management and insurance order workflows, optimized legacy code to improve performance and maintainability, and mentored interns through technical guidance and code reviews.
